THE JOIN MATRIX (target behaviour; "now" notes only where the tree differs)

READ FIRST - three corrections to the analyst reports, found by reading the tree:
1. The tree is AHEAD of the reports. Uncommitted work already exists in C:\ct\test-sites\tambola: z.js +96 lines (country list and CTPhone parser lines 84-123, joinNeeds/markOf/joinWho 133-149, bindJoin checks 883-907, saved wait keeps cc/e164), z.css (.zphone, .zreq, .zopt), worker.ts (digitsOf now takes 8+ digits when typed with + or 00; id mode looks the ID up FIRST like "either" and keeps a typed mobile as contact: idHit/extraDigits, code id-used), local.ts latency knob, and a temporary apps/edge/test/join-probe.test.ts. The plan below builds on this tree and must not revert it.
2. Production per-network join limits are 600 a minute and 20,000 a day (pages/wrangler.toml lines 19-20). The 200/1500 figures in the reports are only code defaults used when the variables are unset.
3. Only four of the six reports arrived (join-form-ui, join-server, invites-links, countries-phone). The fifth was cut off at "data-" and the sixth is missing. Data capture, organizer view and tests below come from the four reports plus my own reads of worker.ts 1485-1685, z.js, guide.js 374-421 and people.ts.

DECISIONS TAKEN WHERE THE REQUIREMENTS LEAVE ROOM (each can be changed without rework)
D1 Anyone/no validation: mobile stays the one mandatory field, name optional, ID hidden. A real "no contact" mode would key identity on the device, which breaks "second phone" recovery; offer it later as its own project.
D2 Length policy: India is hard (exactly 10 digits, first digit 6-9). Every other country is checked against its national length range from the table and a mismatch is a SOFT stop: the message names the country and the count and says "press the button again if it is right". The second press with the same text goes through. A wrong table row can therefore never lock a real person out. Only 8-15 digits in all (country code included) is a hard rule.
D3 Name: the Name box is always shown as [O] with the hint. The server uses the list name when it has one and returns the first name, so the ticket greets "Welcome, Asha". Phase 2 (owner choice): hide the box once the ID is entered, using a guarded lookup (needs the consent ticks in the request, counts hits as well as misses per network, returns a first name only). For personal links, a lookup by token is safe (token is a secret) and shows "Hi <first name>".
D4 Unknown employee ID in an open game: keep today's behaviour (waiting room, so the organizer decides) but say so truthfully, and fix the console sentence "You do not need to approve anyone" for ID games.
D5 Guest link in a list-only game: until the owner chooses, tell the truth on the ticket card and the invitation text ("your guest asks to join and is let in by you or the organizer"). Option for later: a valid guest link inside the guest's quota counts as validation.
D6 Identity hash stays "last 10 digits" in 1.2.x (live rosters depend on it). Phase 2: hash full number for non-India numbers with a dual lookup.

WRONG INPUT: exact messages (client shows them under the box at once and sends nothing; the server returns the same words for hand-made requests)
- Mobile blank, mandatory: "Please type your mobile number."
- Letters or symbols: "A mobile number has digits only. You can use spaces, + and -."
- India, wrong count: "An Indian mobile number has 10 digits. You typed 9. Please check it."
- India, first digit: "An Indian mobile number starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9."
- Other country, count outside its range (soft): "A mobile number in Singapore usually has 8 digits. You typed 7. Please check it. If it is right, press the button again."
- Total digits outside 8-15: "That does not look like a mobile number. Please check the country and the digits."
- Unknown +code: "We do not know that country code. Please pick your country from the list."
- ID blank: "Please type your employee ID." Both blank: "Please type your employee ID and your mobile number." Either blank: "Please type your employee ID or your mobile number."
- ID bad characters or too long: "An employee ID can have letters, numbers and . _ - / only, up to 30 characters."
- ID not on list: waiting card (row 14), never a red error.
- Boxes not ticked: the button stays off and the hint says which box is left.
- Game full: "This game is full. Please ask your organizer." Busy (429/503): "Many people are joining right now. Please wait a moment and press the button again." with a Try again button.
gaps:
PRIORITISED GAP LIST (merged and de-duplicated from the four reports I received, checked against the tree). Status: OPEN = still in the tree; IN-TREE = already changed in the uncommitted work, needs tests; DECISION = owner choice, default taken in the matrix. Line numbers are for the working tree as read now (HEAD is 3 lines earlier after worker.ts:1489).

BLOCKER
G1 [OPEN] Nothing in the uncommitted join rewrite is committed or covered by a committed test. join-probe.test.ts is a throwaway that only prints. Join DOM tests load z.js without guide.js and never type into #emp, #cc, or ID plus mobile together. A release on top of this is unverified. Fix: convert the probe into asserting tests (see test matrix), add DOM tests, commit in small steps.
G2 [OPEN] Prize confirm (winners.ts:28 digitsOf = slice(-10); :85-91 changed-check; z.js:317 card). A winner in the UAE confirming +971 50 123 4567 is stored as 1501234567; any number under 10 digits (Singapore, Hong Kong) is refused "Please enter a valid mobile number." The prize contact is the one place the owner needs the number. Fix: use the shared phone module, store full country-code digits, compare edits on the last 10 only, add the Country list to the card.

HIGH
G3 [OPEN, confirmed by reading] The help panel rewrites the waiting card. The card is div.zcard.zwait role="status" (z.js:154), about 200 characters, with no input inside; guide.js MSGSEL includes [role="status"] (376), okToUpgrade accepts it (380-385), and the catalog entry at guide.js:95 matches "This engagement is by invitation", so upgrade() (387-399) replaces the card with "This game is by invitation ... ask the Organizer to add your mobile number. Then open your link again." The same applies to the declined (entry 202) and removed cards. A person told to wait is told to leave, and the wording names the mobile number in ID games. Fix: add data-ctg-skip to the waiting/declined/lapsed/removed/gone cards and honour it in okToUpgrade and leafMessage; add a player wording for "by invitation". Test with guide.js loaded.
G4 [OPEN] Mode "both": mobile listed with ID X, person types ID Y: worker.ts:1619 sets idMiss, wait() runs, the organizer presses Admit, decideWaiting (people.ts:510-533) only marks the row admitted because a person row exists, the page re-sends the same join, idMiss fires again, the answer is 403 waiting again, once per 5 s until "too many tries" (about 2.5 min). Fix: in join, a waiting row for this identity with status admitted overrides idMiss; wait() never answers "waiting" for an admitted row.
G5 [OPEN] Check-in (checkin.ts:88, 103-104; z.js:725-727): an ID-only person with no mobile on file must tick "This mobile number is correct" for an empty box; an edited number must match ^[6-9]\d{9}$ ("The mobile number needs 10 digits"), so nobody abroad can correct a number; maxlength 14 cuts +971 50 123 4567; an unchanged Indian number retyped is counted as an edit. Check-in is mandatory for new games. Fix: confirmMobile required only when a number is on file; shared parser with Country list; compare on last 10; maxlength 20.
G6 [OPEN] Name requirement not met: the page cannot tell whether the list holds a name, the server silently keeps the list name (worker.ts:1668), nothing is echoed, personal-link people are never asked even when the list has no name (z.js:164 hides the box). Fix per D3: reply carries nameOnFile and firstName; ticket greets by name; personal-link Name [O] when the list has none (phase 2 token lookup).
G7 [IN-TREE, partial] Per-country length. The tree accepts any non-India number with 8-15 digits in all (z.js:113-117) and the server 8+ digits when typed with + or 00. No per-country range, hint, or counter. Trunk handling is wrong for several countries: only Cote d'Ivoire keeps a leading 0 (z.js:90), but Benin, Gabon, Congo (Rep.) and Italy numbers contain their 0; Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Lithuania use 8 as the trunk (a Russian typing 8 912 345 67 89 is accepted as +7 89123456789); Hungary uses 06. About 14 territories are missing from the list (AX, AC, BQ, BL, MF, PM, SJ, EH, CX, CC, NU, NF, SH, TK, WF, IO). Fix: one table with iso, name, dial, minNational, maxNational, trunk, zeroStays, firm; use soft stop per D2.
G8 [OPEN] Copy hard-wired to "mobile number" (z.js:159 step 2 "Type your number" in every mode; :160 invited-by banner for every from= value and every mode; :167 footer "We use your number..."; needPhone text; consent.js:14-17 K4-A names only name and mobile although the employee ID is also kept). Fix: build step, footer, banner and needPhone text from the mode and from who owns the link; read whoCanJoin (worker.ts info already returns it; z.js noteInfo ignores it) and show the game name. K4 wording is legal text: add a variant naming the employee ID only with owner sign-off and bump TERMS_VERSION in consent.js:6 and brand.ts:6 together (D-note; not in the first cut).
G9 [OPEN] Unknown or mistyped ID in an OPEN game waits with "This engagement is by invitation" (worker.ts:1670, wait() :1665), while the console says "You do not need to approve anyone" (zc.js:797-798). Each mistyped ID is a new waiting row; 500 rows (WAITING_MAX people.ts:37) block everyone; Approve all admits ghost IDs. Fix per D4: truthful text with reason "id-unlisted" (keep status 403, code "waiting", waiting:true), one waiting row per phone, console sentence corrected.
G10 [OPEN] needPhone loop for ID-only people: the token is sent with every attempt (api wrapper), so the ID lookup (`!tok`, worker.ts:1579) is skipped, ph = tok.ph, and link-used (423) returns again; employees-only ID games show no mobile box at all in that state (only [O]). Fix: when the person types an ID and no mobile, the page omits the token; message "ask whoever invited you to send the link again".
G11 [OPEN] Organizer contact kept as last 10 digits (worker.ts:1846, 1862, 1874 cp.slice(-10); 1855 length 10-15) and re-read as Indian (people.ts:465): an organizer in Singapore ends up with +91 6591234567 in wa.me links, and a +971 organizer is rejected. Fix: store full digits, read back through the shared parser.
G12 [OPEN] Guest common link in a list-only game (every console-made invitation game): the guest's friend always waits (worker.ts:1670), guests have no approver screen (no waiting UI in z.js), the ticket card promises "Your guest joins ... and gets their own ticket" (z.js:467, 476). Fix per D5.
G13 [OPEN, security] Guest API (people.ts:146 callerOf) trusts a ticket id without device proof, and the seat list is public; any player can read another guest's invitees including the full-number WhatsApp link (viewOf :173) and the personal link token. Fix: require the device hash as checkin.ts deviceMatches does; return masked numbers to guests.

MEDIUM
G14 [IN-TREE, verify] Mandatory/optional markers exist (z.js:140). Remaining: the two consent boxes are not marked; no aria-describedby/aria-invalid on errors; guide's "still needed" hint (guide.js:431-444) cannot name text boxes (no data-need); the "alt" wording ("mandatory without an employee ID") needs a one-line "Give at least one" for the either mode.
G15 [OPEN] Server number rules still loose or inconsistent: letters silently dropped; "+91" with 8-11 digits starting 91 passes because the minimum is 8 whenever a + is typed (worker.ts:1491); an explicit +91 number is not held to 10 digits and 6-9; bare numbers from older pages are stored as typed (10 digits) while lists store 91+10, so people.ts wa.me links and exports differ by how a person joined; no country-code table check. Fix: explicit-country forms (+ or 00) go through the shared table; bare numbers keep the 1.1.8 rule; always store country-code digits (bare 10 digits starting 6-9 get 91).
G16 [OPEN] ID-miss counter (worker.ts:1621-1628): counts before the consent and removed checks and on every retry of the same wrong ID; 30 per 10 minutes per network (not configurable) can lock out an office. Fix: count only the first sight of a distinct (network, ID) after consent; make the limit a variable.
G17 [OPEN] Co-host and level-1 guest limits in an OPEN game send the 101st person to the waiting room with "This invitation has already been used by 100 people" (worker.ts:1672). Fix: open game falls back to the organizer's list; list game keeps waiting.
G18 [OPEN] Full game answers a flat 409 (worker.ts:1637) but the organizer help promises a waiting room (zc.js:225); listed people can find the game full because open joiners fill the places first. Fix: correct the help, give the answer a code, reserve places for listed people in open games.
G19 [OPEN] Waiting room: polling every 5 s with no jitter or back-off; "Type it again" leaves the old row; a declined number stays declined for ever; a "gone" answer keeps the card on screen. Fix: jitter, slow to 15-30 s after a minute, withdraw call, handle state gone.
G20 [OPEN] Typed values and ticks are lost on reload or app switch; paint() skips a redraw only when the first existing box is focused. Fix: keep country, number, ID, name in sessionStorage; guard any focused input in the form.
G21 [OPEN] Unbind / person / forget / mark accept a mobile number only (worker.ts:1750 and neighbours): an ID-keyed participant gets "That number has not joined"; ID-only people have no personal-link button in the console (zc.js:733). Fix: accept empId, seat number or person id; add Copy personal link for every row.
G22 [OPEN] Changing verify mode or employees-only after people are listed orphans them silently; turning employees-only off leaves the game list-only (worker.ts:2005-2009). Fix: warn with counts; return whoCanJoin explicitly.
G23 [OPEN] Co-host cannot add anyone in an employees-only ID game (zc.js:668 colsAllowed returns mobile only; people.ts:289 then rejects every row). Fix: give the Co-host the mode's columns or hide the form with a reason.
G24 [OPEN] Name cleaning at join is weaker than in the lists (worker.ts cleanName strips only <>`; people.ts also strips control characters and a leading = + - @), so a name like =HYPERLINK(...) reaches reports and CSV. Fix: reuse the people.ts cleaner in join and check-in.
G25 [OPEN] Same ID on a second phone, second-phone wording, leaving the game: "removed by the organizer" shown to a person who left; list line deleted before the start (rights.ts:74-83). Fix: code left-by-self with its own text; keep the line as "left" before the start.
G26 [IN-TREE, verify] id mode with ID plus mobile (was: waiting room, burned an ID-miss try). Needs the tests listed; also the "id-used" message for an ID on a second phone.

LOW
G27 Production join limits are 600 a minute and 20,000 a day (pages/wrangler.toml), so a 1,000-person single-address crowd is fine unless more than 600 arrive in one minute; busy 429 has no Try again button and the help panel calls it "our side". Fix: Try again button and its own wait wording.
G28 Identity hash collisions across countries (last 10 digits) and national numbers typed bare on pre-1.2 pages for 8-9 digit countries never match a listed +cc number. Rollout note, D6.
G29 Masks show no country (+cc ****567); CSV and reports print bare digits that spreadsheets turn into 9.19877E+11. Fix: shared mask/format, write "+cc national" as text.
G30 Join after the game ended is not refused (verify with a test before changing). Revoked Host/Co-host links are silently credited to the organizer (record via). Roster enumeration oracles on guest add and both-mode need-id. daily write accounting (spend 3) is an estimate. Shared phones: state the "one phone, one ticket" rule on the form. Accessibility: the whole #app is aria-live.
plan:
IMPLEMENTATION PLAN (ordered; each step ends green before the next; the laptop is short of memory, so run test files in groups, one process at a time, and never start a browser and a test run together)

STEP 0 - Protect what exists
- Take a snapshot commit of the uncommitted tree on a new branch (do not stash, do not revert): z.js, z.css, worker.ts, local.ts, nodephone.mjs, start-tambola.ps1, join-probe.test.ts. Confirm no other session is editing the same files before the first edit.
- Treat join-probe.test.ts as scaffolding: its five scenarios become real assertions in Step 6, then the file is deleted.

STEP 1 - One phone module (single source of truth)
- Create packages/beacon/src/dial.ts with the table [iso, name, dial, minNational, maxNational, trunk, zeroStays, firm] plus parse(iso, typed), validate(), show(), mask(). Seed it from the countries-phone report's 244-row table and the 229 rows now inline in z.js. The report's ranges are from memory: mark `firm` only where the length is fixed and well known (IN 10, US/CA/NANP 10, GB 10, SG 8, HK 8, AE 9, SA 9, AU 9, FR 9, ES 9, NL 9, PK 10, BD 10, LK 9, NP 10, CN 11, JP 10, PH 10, TH 9, ZA 9, NG 10, KE 9, EG 10, QA/KW/BH/OM 8, IL 9, TR 10, MX 10), everything else wide. Trunk fields: 0 default, 8 for RU/KZ/BY/UZ/TM/LT, 06 for HU, none for IT/BJ/GA/CG/CI (zero stays).
- Build it to apps/web/public/dial.js with the same pattern as zgame.js; import dial.ts directly in the Worker and in checkin.ts/winners.ts. Wire the new file in: pages/build.mjs FILES (a file missing there is silently NOT shipped), zsw.js FILES, script tags in z.html and zc.html, and the file list in apps/edge/test/ai-mail.test.ts:114. z.js stops carrying its own copy (remove CT_ROWS and CTPhone body; keep window.CTPhone as a thin alias so nothing else breaks).
- Keep India behaviour exactly as in the tree (10 digits, 6-9). Non-India: policy D2 (soft stop on a firm-range mismatch; hard only outside 8-15 digits in all).
- Do NOT change the hash (last 10 digits).

STEP 2 - Server join contract (backwards compatible; field names, status codes and `code` values do not change)
a) digitsOf: a number typed with + or 00 goes through dial.ts (known code, 8-15 digits, India held to 10 and 6-9). A bare number keeps the 1.1.8 rule (10-15 digits). This keeps older open pages and the protocol phones in tools/load-tests (which send phone, name, empId, device, consent with bare 10-digit numbers) behaving exactly as before.
b) Store country-code digits for every new join (bare 10 digits starting 6-9 get 91 in front); readers that build wa.me links tolerate old 10-digit rows.
c) Admitted is final: before computing idMiss, look for a waiting row for this identity with status admitted and skip the ID-mismatch/idMiss rule for it (fixes G4); wait() never answers "waiting" for an admitted row.
d) ID-miss counter moves after the consent check and only on the first sight of a distinct (network, ID); limit read from a variable with today's 30 as default.
e) Messages: waiting reply for an ID miss gets the truthful text and an extra field reason:"id-unlisted" (status 403, code "waiting", waiting:true, wid, with all unchanged). need-id and "Enter a valid mobile number." get an extra field ("id" or "mobile") so the page can mark the right box; the text becomes mode-specific ("Enter your employee ID and your mobile number." for both+ID-only).
f) Join reply (success) gains optional nameOnFile (bool) and firstName; nothing existing is removed.
g) Open game, Co-host/guest quota full: fall back to the organizer instead of waiting (G17). List game unchanged.
h) cleanName reuses the people.ts cleaner (G24). Game-full answer gets code "full".
i) Phase 2, behind owner choice: POST /api/z/:id/who (token or ID+consent) for the name echo; guarded as described in D3.

STEP 3 - Participant page (z.js, z.css, guide.js)
a) Keep the tree's joinNeeds/markOf layout; make the copy come from the mode: step 2 text, footer, invited-by banner by owner kind, needPhone text; read whoCanJoin and the game name from /info; add the one "who can join" line.
b) Country list: show name and +code (flags are decoration only; Windows desktops draw letters), India first, remembered per phone (ctz-cc), placeholder and live hint from the table ("India: 10 digits"), soft-stop logic for D2 (remember the text that was warned; the same text on the second press is sent). Preview line "We will use +65 9123 4567".
c) Mark the two consent boxes [M]; add aria-describedby/aria-invalid and an inline message under the offending box; data-need on every mandatory input so guide.js can name what is missing.
d) needPhone: omit the token when the person typed an ID and no mobile (G10).
e) Persist typed country/number/ID/name in sessionStorage; focus guard on any focused input (G20).
f) Waiting poll with jitter and back-off; "Type it again" calls a withdraw; handle state gone (G19).
g) guide.js: data-ctg-skip on the waiting/declined/lapsed/removed/gone cards, honoured in okToUpgrade and leafMessage; player wording for "by invitation" that says "wait"; mode-neutral wording for the mobile and ID guides ("Type your mobile number with its country", no "10-digit", no "outside India"); Try again button for busy answers (G27).
